'''Bobby''' is a character who is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Bobby is, presumably, a member of the [[Sindacco Crime Family]], a cosa nostra mob family.

He lives on the East coast of the [[United States of America]], which could be [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]], [[Carcer City (3D Universe)|Carcer City]] or [[Vice City (3D Universe)|Vice City]].

It is mentioned by two members of the Sindacco family that he had recently become an open homosexual.

He and [[Lance Urwell]] are the only known members of the Sindacco family to still be alive.
